question: What form results from constant practice of yoga for sixteen years?
premises: dvi aṣṭa varṣa ākṛtiḥ bhavet is stated
inference: Through constant practice of yoga, one becomes of a form after sixteen years.
uncertainties: whether dvi aṣṭa means sixteen or two eights
plain_english: Through constant practice of yoga, one becomes of a form after sixteen years.
